title: NHL Stack Health
description: Request rate, response time, workloads, jobs and database for the nhl-odds stack.

panels.title: Public requests / min
panels.description: All real-user traffic, counted at the Cloudflare tunnel (pages, assets and API calls).

panels.title: API requests / min
panels.description: Requests handled by the webapi (proxied from nginx /api and /mcp).

panels.title: API p50 response
panels.description: Median API response time over the last 5 minutes (MCP excluded).

panels.title: API p95 response
panels.description: 95th percentile API response time over the last 5 minutes (MCP excluded).

panels.title: Tunnel errors (5xx)
panels.description: 5xx responses seen by real users, including nginx/frontend failures.

panels.title: p95 response time by endpoint
panels.description: Which API routes are slow. Gaps mean the route had no traffic in that window.

targets.expr: histogram_quantile(0.95, sum by (le, endpoint) (rate(http_request_duration_seconds_bucket{namespace="nhl-odds", container="webapi", endpoint!~"mcp.*|"}[5m])))

panels.title: Requests by endpoint
panels.description: Requests per minute per API route.

panels.title: Where API time goes (total seconds, dashboard range)
panels.description: Calls x average duration. The top bar is the endpoint where optimizing saves the most server time.

panels.title: Average response by endpoint (dashboard range)
panels.description: Mean response time per route over the selected range.

targets.expr: sort_desc(sum by (endpoint) (increase(http_request_duration_seconds_sum{namespace="nhl-odds", container="webapi", endpoint!~"mcp.*|"}[$__range])) / sum by (endpoint) (increase(http_request_duration_seconds_count{namespace="nhl-odds", container="webapi", endpoint!~"mcp.*|"}[$__range])))

panels.title: Responses by status (public)
panels.description: Responses per minute at the tunnel, by HTTP status.

panels.title: LAN response time (Traefik)
panels.description: Only nhl-odds.kubecluster (LAN) traffic passes through Traefik; public traffic does not.

panels.title: Restarts (24h)
panels.description: Pods that restarted in the last 24h (empty = none).

targets.expr: sum by (pod) (container_memory_working_set_bytes{namespace="nhl-odds", container="webapi"}) / sum by (pod) (kube_pod_container_resource_limits{namespace="nhl-odds", container="webapi", resource="memory"})

panels.title: Time since last successful run
panels.description: All jobs run daily; yellow after 26h, red after 30h means a run was missed or failed.

panels.title: Failed jobs (still listed)
panels.description: Failed Job objects kept by the CronJobs' history limits.

panels.title: Cache hit ratio
panels.description: Share of reads served from shared_buffers. Below ~99% the DB is going to disk.

targets.expr: sum(rate(cnpg_pg_stat_database_blks_hit{namespace="nhl-odds", pod=~"nhl-odds-database-.*", datname="nhl"}[5m])) / clamp_min(sum(rate(cnpg_pg_stat_database_blks_hit{namespace="nhl-odds", pod=~"nhl-odds-database-.*", datname="nhl"}[5m])) + sum(rate(cnpg_pg_stat_database_blks_read{namespace="nhl-odds", pod=~"nhl-odds-database-.*", datname="nhl"}[5m])), 1e-9)

panels.title: DB volumes not healthy
panels.description: Longhorn volumes for the database that are degraded, faulted or unknown.

targets.expr: sum by (pod, state) (cnpg_backends_total{namespace="nhl-odds", pod=~"nhl-odds-database-.*", datname="nhl", usename!="cnpg_metrics_exporter"})
